lines.zh: 我挂在屋檐下的叶子上。
lines.en: I hang from a leaf beneath the eaves.

lines.zh: 村里有人走过，我就轻晃。
lines.en: Villagers pass and I sway slightly.

lines.zh: 我的壳是灰白的，像旧布。
lines.en: My case is grey-white, like old cloth.
I turn half a circle on my thread.
The wind is stronger under the eaves.
I keep to the wall side, out of the rain.
A chicken scratches the dirt below.
The shaking sets me swinging.

lines.zh: 我的丝缠在叶柄上，绕了三圈。
lines.en: My silk is wound three times around the stalk.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转到背光的一面。
lines.en: I turn slowly to the shaded side.
The days here pass very slowly.
I am waiting to finish changing.

lines.zh: 墙上的影子移过去，我才知道过了半天。
lines.en: The wall's shadow moves and I know half a day has gone.
I sink quiet again.
A dog barks far off, muffled.

lines.zh: 这地方的味道是柴火和土。
lines.en: This place smells of firewood and earth.

lines.zh: 我不动，像一块挂着的布头。
lines.en: I hold still, like a scrap of hanging cloth.
It is dark in here, and warm.
My old skin lies shrivelled below.
I count the drips from the eaves.

lines.zh: 我是衣蛾的蛹，这一点我知道。
lines.en: I am a clothes moth's pupa. I know that.
The villagers will not notice me.
That suits me well enough.

lines.zh: 光从窗纸透过来，是黄的。
lines.en: Light comes through the paper window, yellow.
I hear someone weaving.
I know that sound well.
The case is tightening. Soon.
I stretch myself out.
Only when you look up am I seen.

lines.zh: 你抬手就够到我这枚茧。
lines.en: One lift of your hand reaches my case.

lines.zh: 你伸手指了指，没有说话。
lines.en: You point at me without speaking.
I am not fruit. Do not pick me.
You lean close; I am looking too.
Through a layer of case, not clearly.
You walk away with soft steps.
I go on hanging here.
Villagers usually ignore me.

lines.zh: 你不一样，这让我有点紧张。
lines.en: You are different. It makes me a little nervous.
The case is pressed and my thread snaps taut.
I cannot stop swinging.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的丝松了一寸。
lines.en: That slackened my silk by an inch.
I draw tight inside.
Something seeps out.
My silk is creaking.
The wall is getting further away.
I am about to fall.
I hold on with all I have.
It has not come to that yet.
I do not eat. I am in my case.

lines.zh: 叶子递到我面前，我不吃。
lines.en: The leaf is held up to me, and I don't eat.
I know that smell.
But I cannot open my mouth now.
When I come out, I will look for cloth.
You may keep it if you like.

lines.zh: 叶子对我只是挂着的地方。
lines.en: A leaf is only somewhere to hang.
You lower the leaf. Good.
Then I can change in peace.
Do not tease me again.

lines.zh: 你碰了叶柄，我摆得很厉害。
lines.en: You touch the stalk and I swing hard.
I strike the wall.
A pale mark appears on my case.

lines.zh: 我在半空转了两圈才停。
lines.en: I spin twice in the air before stopping.
The village cat is watching from below.
I draw my thread in a little.
Closer to the wall. Safer.
Do not touch it again.
That was very unpleasant.
I need to be left in peace.

lines.zh: 屋檐另一头也挂着一个。
lines.en: There is another hanging at the other end of the eaves.
A whole wall lies between us.
We are both grey-white.

lines.zh: 等我们出来，会飞向同一盏灯。
lines.en: When we emerge, we will fly to the same lamp.
We will speak of other things then.
For now I am only a pupa.

lines.zh: 风把墙上的影子摇了摇。
lines.en: The wind stirs the shadow on the wall.

lines.zh: 我听见它那边的丝在响。
lines.en: I hear its silk creak over there.
Two cocoons, waiting together across a wall.
That is all there is.

lines.zh: 我是一层硬丝，谁也搬不动。
lines.en: I'm a hard layer of silk; nothing moves me.
Something falls on the windowsill.
It is not far from me.
A chicken hops up and takes it.
I hear wings flapping.
Then it is quiet again.
Some dust is left on the sill.

lines.zh: 窗台上的灰，我没法去捡。
lines.en: Ash on the sill; I can't go pick it up.
Nothing here stays long.
I too am only hanging here for a time.
Something is approaching the eaves.

lines.zh: 我听见爪子刮瓦的声音。
lines.en: I hear claws scraping tile.
It is lighter than a chicken.
I hold my thread taut.
It comes down along the beam.
I press close against the leaf.
Its shadow covers me.
I do not move at all.
It did not recognize me.
My silk is all inside this cocoon.
It circles under the eaves.
I do not watch it. I only listen.

lines.zh: 它的脚步停在我正下方。
lines.en: Its steps stop right below me.
I dare not even stir the silk.
The wind swings me slightly.
It looks up at the eaves.
It leaps once. It cannot reach.
I hold my silk taut, out of sight.
I still do not fall.
At last it leaves.
I cannot strike. I can only swing.
I swing and knock the beam.
The sound echoes under the eaves.
Whatever it was is startled.
It steps back.
The leaf comes loose.
I fall with it.
I land in the straw, unbroken.
The straw buries me.
This is safer, in fact.

lines.zh: 我在屋檐下的叶背结好了壳。
lines.en: I finish my case under a leaf beneath the eaves.

lines.zh: 这里是村庄，有人的味道。
lines.en: This is a village. It smells of people.
I chose a household wall.
The wall is rammed earth, and warm.
Chickens walk about the yard.
I hang higher than they reach.
The eaves keep off the rain.
My old skin is shed below.
Inside the case, I begin to stir.
Village days are long.

lines.zh: 屋檐下起了火，热气把壳烤软。
lines.en: Fire under the eaves softens my case with heat.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下去，壳磕在石阶上。
lines.en: I fall from height and strike the stone step.

lines.zh: 雨水顺着墙淌下来，泡透了我的壳。
lines.en: Rain runs down the wall and soaks my case.

lines.zh: 气浪把屋檐掀飞，我也被带走。
lines.en: The blast tears off the eaves and carries me with them.

lines.zh: 一根木刺穿过我的叶子。
lines.en: A splinter of wood pierces my leaf.

lines.zh: 怪光透进壳里，我全身抽紧。
lines.en: Strange light enters the case and every part of me clenches.
The strength for changing is nearly spent.

lines.zh: 雷落在屋脊上，整面墙都在响。
lines.en: Lightning hits the roof ridge and the whole wall rings.

lines.zh: 屋檐不见了，我在黑里往下飘。
lines.en: The eaves are gone and I drift down through black.
